(a) "Scaling-only fix": a SCALING-only worker switch, inert for C1-C12 and preregistered before any reading run; the claim-id resume check: a resumed worker keeps its hold only if its own claimOpId still holds; a NOTICE that arrives during a hold is kept until the hold ends; F-G1-1 is rewritten as a finding about packet 1's scripted worker, a harness limit of earlier packets never exercised before, stated with both paths. Your unfinished-run rule is accepted: lastMergeTick = the deadline, makespanRatioMilli follows, and finishedSeeds is reported per point. NOTEs D2-2..7 are accepted as listed.

"Accept, record it": the stale-claim mechanism is closed for Q-P4-D2-1's purpose; the transient is stated in F-G1-1 and section 4.9: a stale hold ends within one RENEW round trip, and adds only explained duplicate work at CENTRAL points (about 39 of 256 stalls at N=1, r3's distribution), recorded as it reads; no third extension.
